title: What are malicious apps?
body:
What are malicious apps?

A malicious app is a program that looks normal, but does bad things:
• Steals your photos
• Reads messages
• Sees where you are
• Spends your money
• Infects phone with virus

They often hide in:
• Free games
• "Cool" programs
• Apps from unknown developers

✅ ALADDIN checks apps and warns of danger before you open or download them.
